presets.title: Presets

objects.title: Objects
objects.addGeometry: Add inert geometry (not part of the physical model):
objects.inertHint: Inert geometry is drawn for reference only. It has no effect on the computed fields; physical roles for extended bodies are not supported yet.
objects.empty: The scene is empty. Add a charge or choose a preset.
params.nothingSelected: Select an object to edit its parameters.
params.name: Name
params.roleHint: Roles that no implemented solver supports are listed but cannot be selected.
params.inertNote: This object is inert geometry: it is drawn, but it is not part of the physical model and does not change the field.
params.chargeHint: Charge q in coulombs (shown in nC). The field direction follows the positive test-charge convention.
params.rotationNote: Rotation uses intrinsic XYZ Euler angles (R = Rx·Ry·Rz). Rotating or scaling an ideal point charge does not change its field.
params.domainHint: Bounds of the sampled and displayed region. The analytical model itself is unbounded.
viz.arrowsHint: Each arrow shows the direction of E at its centre point; colour encodes |E|. Arrows are samples of the vector field, not field lines and not particle paths.
viz.arrowLengthHint: Visualization choice only; the computed field is not affected.
accuracy.title: Accuracy and cost
accuracy.explain: The point-charge solution is exact at every sample point; quality only changes how densely the field is sampled. Preview ({preview} samples along the slice) is used while dragging, normal ({normal}) otherwise. A high-resolution solve ({high}) runs as a cancellable job on the solver worker and costs about 16× more.
accuracy.workerOffline: No solver worker is online, so queued jobs are unavailable. Interactive solving still works.
eq.intro: Every equation is shown with its status for the current physical model. Click an equation for its meaning, symbols and assumptions.
eq.introBeginner: These equations describe the current scene. Click one to see what it means. Switch to Advanced to also see the equations that do not apply here, and why.
eq.status.not_applicable: Not applicable to the current model
eq.status.not_evaluated: Not evaluated by the current solver
results.noApproximation: No result is shown: an unsupported configuration is never replaced by a simpler, inaccurate model.
probe.title: Field probe
probe.enableHint: Choose the Probe tool, then click on the slice plane.
probe.clickHint: Click on the slice plane to place the probe.
probe.undefined: The probe coincides with a point charge, where the field is singular and undefined.
probe.exactNote: Evaluated by the solver at this exact point in 64-bit precision (not interpolated from the displayed grid).
diag.note: Ranges are computed in 64-bit precision before the 32-bit transport cast; vector entries give the magnitude. The analytical solution has no discretization error; the only numerical error is floating-point rounding.
projects.title: Projects
projects.name: Project name
view.crossSection: Plane {where} through the full 3D configuration (not a two-dimensional model; nothing is assumed invariant along the normal). Arrows are the 3D vectors E seen along the plane normal, i.e. their in-plane projection.
view.controls2d: Drag a charge to move it · right-drag: pan · wheel: zoom
view.3d: Full 3D model, z up. Slice plane at {where}.
view.controls3d: Drag: orbit · right-drag: pan · wheel: zoom · select an object to use the gizmo
legend.aid: Colour ranges span the 2nd–98th percentile and are clamped beyond; charge markers have no physical size.
